## Get a daily Sellf sales report on Telegram

### How it works
Every morning at 9:00 this workflow pulls your shop's numbers from the [Sellf](https://github.com/jurczykpawel/sellf) - a self-hosted checkout platform for digital products REST API - today's revenue and orders, active users and products, plus the top five products by revenue - formats them into one tidy Telegram message and sends it to your chat. Your daily pulse without opening the admin panel.

### Setup
1. In Sellf admin create an API key (**Settings → API keys**) with the analytics read scope.
2. Fill in **Configuration (EDIT ME)**: your Sellf URL, the API key and your Telegram chat id.
3. Connect your Telegram bot credentials on **Send to Telegram** (create a bot with @BotFather, add it to your chat).
4. Adjust the hour on **Every Day at 9:00** and activate.

### Customization tips
Edit **Format Report** to add refund counts, conversion rates or week-over-week deltas - everything the analytics endpoints return is available. Prefer Slack or Discord? Swap the Telegram node for an HTTP node posting to an incoming webhook.

## Pull the Numbers
Runs every morning and reads today's stats and top products from the Sellf API.

## Report
One readable Telegram message: revenue, orders, users, products, top sellers.
